readScope.method: Sequential full read in seven untruncated chunks; reread u1889-u1890 after a tiny truncation. Draft not assessed during independent read.

coverageLedger: DM cinematic gods watching Dunmar; not party observations. Named deity mentions; preserve framing.
Saka farewell and meaningful gift of storykeeping sheets; Rai/jade dream discussion; purpose of the Awakened Soul and ordinary stories.
July 6 departure, 2.5-day ride, July 8 evening approach Tokra; temple/tree described, inn chosen.
Kirian welcomes party and supplies messages from Kassi, Fallthra, Govir, Kaleha; Riswynn whereabouts.
Kenzo visits Iron Swan and retrieves Riswynn; do not invent Vistra encounter.
Return Kirian common room, reunited party discusses separate cured/refusing prisoners and soul mirrors; named Vistra reported.
Kenzo interviews Kirian before bed July 8; whole life-story conversation despite preceding DM attempted next-morning transition.
Kobold lore/table discussion; no named kobold entities.
July 9 Garret at Red Lily, Tye summoned for package, Charmhearts present upstairs, Callie mentioned; halfling locket/ring entrusted for return; omit ordinary money/garnets/shortsword.
Archives approach and Hardstone workshop; Fallthra, Dag, father/uncle physically present.
Whole Fallthra/Dag follow-up conversation and soul check; reassurance framed as beliefs rather than proven divine facts.
Govir chamber: cult ritual alignment, Illyan letters, historical research, Kharsan artifact lead, reorganization request.
Party persuades Ardan to empower Govir and assistants.
Return Govir: promotion, research timelines, later communication, dream symptoms; prior lycanthropy cure not new cure/revival.
Leaves archives, rain begins; July 9 explicitly; portable hole due July 15, not acquired now.
Kaleha temple balcony: Renewal tomorrow, execution planned after feast, rain, tree craft instructions.
Party lodging/travel decisions and move to monastery. No actual shield recovery or crafted staff.
July 10 Renewal feast: Kassi invites research meeting tomorrow, unnamed rider says Lara two days away.
Meta planning remaining scenes/downtime; no future off-record actions imported.
Whole Kassi July 11 research conversation: Gnaeus/Rai dreams, Anida/Yezali, Eukos/Esa and theology. Preserve attributed research/speculation.
Basu approached about living tree wood; promises future branch when available, not immediate acquisition.
Staff/portable-hole joking and downtime planning; no completed crafting or receipt.
Lara returns with mystai and meets party; later day not exactly stated.
Whole private Lara conversation: Sura/Karnas disagreement, Johar proposed escort, divine concealment research, party accepts Darba escort; no direct Johar meeting.

dateAssessment.conclusion: No clear conflict: explicit July 6 departure, July 8 arrival, July 9 rain, July 10 feast, July 11 research; Lara scene later and imprecise. July 13 YAML extension/clarification accepted, not rejected.

calibration: Important newly gifted storykeeping paper qualifies.
Meaningful returned halfling ring/locket qualify despite mundane physical properties.
Omit ordinary coins, garnets, shortsword; omit routine magic gear use.
Plot artifacts qualify only for substantive concealment/research/custody discussion, not every joke or mention.
No off-record Google document, mailed downtime outcome, future artifact receipt, completed execution, or fabricated branch acquisition.
Named NPCs plus useful distinctive unnamed individuals; not generic rumored monsters.
Famous gods/historical figures are mentions, not live encounters; preserve attribution and uncertainty.
